about: Coach Q&A house look (fixed reel to reel). Modelled on how @clubgig_official (Thai relationship-coach reels) edits, studied 2026-10-31: the grammar only, none of their brand, footage or assets.
world: a seated coach answering one question; the face is clean most of the runtime (no running captions); the question card is the hook; each point is a stock B-roll insert with a two-tier label, entered and left through a grainy colour swipe; a tilted keyword now and then; a LINE CTA owns the back 35-40 %; a silent logo end card
layout: 1080x1920 at 30 fps. The face sits roughly y 450-1000. Question card, B-roll label, keyword and CTA all live in the chest band, centred, y 1000-1450 (>= 450 px clear at the bottom for the Instagram UI). Bug at the top edge, y 70-150, small. Question card: 148 px (2x, the owner 10-31), above the head when the chest band is too short.

type.note: Anuphan (OFL, Cadson Demak) covers Thai + Latin in one variable file. The reference uses a heavier rounded Thai sans (Kanit-like); swap family/file here for Kanit 700 if wanted. Text is laid out by the author line by line: Thai has no spaces to wrap on, so the builder never wraps, it shrinks a line to fit and refuses below min_size.

palette.meaning: the block colour carries the question's key line and the label's small line; orange = the offer; everything else is white on the footage

motion.qcard: chest band when it fits under the chin, else above the head (between y top_min and the head): 2x size, shrunk uniformly only as far as the space forces; lines rise in staggered, the block wipes; off with a 0.2 s fade
motion.swipe: 0.6 s centred on the cut: the outgoing picture whips up with blur (0.1 s), yellow field with a red-orange foot slides up, cyan brush on white, blue, orange; the cut happens under the colour; an iris opens in the orange onto the incoming shot; grain over all of it; one whoosh
motion.label: lands as the iris opens (cut + 0.12 s): big line pops 1.12 -> 1, the small line's block wipes in 0.1 s later; leaves with a 3-frame glitch (x jitter + clip slices) under the outgoing swipe
motion.keyword: each line reveals left to right (clip-path) in 0.25 s on its spoken phrase, tilted -6 deg; off with a 0.15 s fade
motion.cta: pops in (scale 0.7 -> 1, back.out 1.7, 0.3 s) with a pop + whoosh, a gentle 2 s float, holds to the end card
motion.snaps: jump-cut rhythm on one plate: instant reframes 1.0 <-> 1.1 at take changes (origin on the face)
motion.end: white card, wordmark fades + rises 20 px in 0.5 s, silence

sound.rule: voice + SFX by role, levels relative to this voice's p95 peak like build.mjs (ui -14, whoosh -12, impact -8 dB): a soft hit on the hook (0.13 s), a whoosh on every swipe, a pop as each label lands, a light whoosh per keyword line, pop + whoosh + pop on the CTA, a ding on the end card. No music bed. (the owner 10-31: more SFX, tadclip's mixing)

vary_per_reel: the question and which line sits on the block (red or maroon), the points and their stock clips, which phrase gets a keyword (0-2), when the CTA starts (~60 % or the pivot sentence), the CTA text and handle, the bug and end-card text
